title: Alignment Ladder: Sprint Check-in & Micro-OKRs
content:
Purpose: use a ladder metaphor to track weekly micro-KPIs (rungs) that ladder up to a quarterly OKR. This is a working scratchpad — messy, iterative.

Context / why now:
- Q1 push to own small product experiment (in-product prompt config UI). Need steady output and measurable wins to justify more cycles.
- Goal is to show 3 incremental customer-facing improvements and one internal reliability win by end of quarter.

The Alignment Ladder (rungs = weekly/biweekly checkpoints):
1) Rung 0 (foundation) — local dev env replicates staging + reproducible test harness.
   - Success metric: 90% of core flows run in <2 failures per 50 runs.
   - Current: flaky around KV cache warmup; need to add small wait/priming script.
   - Action: add priming step to docker-compose, PR local test harness (WIP).

2) Rung 1 — instrumented experiments and telemetry for feature flags.
   - Metric: events emitted for config changes, 95% sampling recorded in Grafana.
   - Current: telemetry exists but missing event types for "override_preview".
   - TODO: add event; ask SRE for tag guidance (ping @marta). Jira: DEVX-412.

3) Rung 2 — user-facing small improvements (A/B rollouts).
   - Metric: +5% click-through on advanced prompt toggle in product when rolled to 10% audience.
   - Current: mockup done; needs frontend hook and backend route.
   - Blocker: frontend availability (Devon out Fri). Plan: pair Mon/Tue.

4) Rung 3 — quality/regression guardrails (evals + alerts).
   - Metric: create 4 prompt-eval cases that cover high-severity regressions; threshold alerts configured.
   - Current: draft evals in repo under /evals/experimental. Need PR to merge and connect to Optimize.

Weekly cadence (what I do each check-in):
- Monday: update ladder, pick 2 tangible tasks (one product, one infra).
- Midweek: quick demo to teammate for feedback (5–10min).
- Friday: short retro — what shipped, what failed, next week's rungs.

This week's quick snapshot (week of 2026-03-09):
- Wins:
  - Hooked telemetry for override_preview (event schema updated).
  - Local harness now has priming script; reduced 50-run failure rate from 18% -> 6% (still noisy).
- Misses:
  - Frontend slot delayed; no A/B rollout started.
  - Eval thresholds not yet wired to alerting.
- Learnings:
  - Small priming delay removed 80% of flakiness — indicates init race with KV cache. Consider short-term backoff loop.

Next actions (prioritized):
1) Finish frontend route and small toggle (deadline: 2026-03-16). Owner: Ivy + Devon.
2) Merge evals PR and add alert rule to Optimize (deadline: 2026-03-18). Owner: Ivy.
3) Add priming wait + backoff in serving dev harness (deadline: 2026-03-12) — low-risk rollback if causes perf regressions.
4) Write short one-pager visible to PM about impact of telemetry on rollout decisions (deadline: 2026-03-20).

Measurement rubric (how I judge success):
- Leading indicators: CI pass rate, telemetry event counts, dev review feedbacks (qual).
- Lagging indicators: A/B metric lift (click-through), number of customer-reported regressions, time-to-restore.
- Personal cadence metric: shipped change every other week (target 6 changes in Q).

Open questions / experiments to run:
- Is 5% CTR lift the right product signal for this toggle? Maybe track engagement time instead. Need to consult PM (add to 1-pager).
- Can we automate priming in the runtime instead of in the harness? Risk: touching runtime; benefit: fewer ad-hoc scripts.
- What percentage of users should get canary config to get statistically meaningful signal given current DAU? Quick calc needed (ping analytics).

Retrospective notes (recent two sprints):
- What went well: smaller scopes shipped faster when explicit acceptance criteria were set at the start.
- What didn't: vague success metrics slowed decisions and caused domino delays.
- Improvement: standardize a 2-line acceptance (metric + rollback plan) for any user-facing change.

Scratch area (notes to self):
- Draft subject line for sync with PM: "Quick check: telemetry + canary plan for prompt-config toggle"
- Slack thread to start: #devx-feature-rollouts -> link examples from past canary docs.
- Quick refs: Confluence template: Personal OKR Templates (see linked artifacts).

Backlog (loosely prioritized):
- refactor: extract telemetry layer helpers (low effort).
- experiment: compile small prompt-eval harness that runs nightly on dedicated runner.
- learning: read notes on greedy vs. conservative canary sizing (from analytics).

Final note: this doc is intentionally rough. The ladder metaphor keeps me honest: each rung should be a binary check (done/blocked) or have a clear metric. If it becomes fuzzy, refactor the rung into smaller steps.

Sign-off: Ivy C. (will tidy and snapshot into Confluence when I have a clean rollout path).
